findings.title: dir-tree fallback uses eval with user-controlled project path context
findings.evidence: shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:26 runs eval find with PROJECT_DIR, DEPTH, and dynamic EXCLUDES.

evidence_checks.claim: The fallback path uses eval to build and execute the find command.

required_claims: The fallback command is reachable when tree is unavailable.
The command line is constructed through eval.
The command includes project path and depth inputs from the overview invocation context.
claim_review.refutation_check: shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:11 only checks that PROJECT_DIR is a directory; no direct refutation of eval-based command construction was found.

severity_calibration.team_use_impact: Overview is meant to inspect arbitrary project paths; unsafe fallback command construction can mislead or fail scans in team onboarding flows.
severity_calibration.rationale: The issue is major because it affects a helper script at the input boundary, but it is not P0 because it is limited to the fallback path when tree is unavailable.

findings.impact: A project path or depth edge case can be interpreted by the shell during fallback scanning instead of being treated as data.
findings.verification_hint: Replace eval with an argv array, validate depth as a positive integer, and test paths containing spaces and shell metacharacters.

findings.title: Overview behavior is covered by prompt fixtures but not executable eval gates
findings.evidence: shared/skills/overview/test-prompts.json:5 stores expected behavior as natural-language text.
findings.impact: Mode confirmation, write refusal, Mermaid checks, and scan failure handling can regress without a deterministic gate.
findings.verification_hint: Add executable overview evals or focused tests covering mode confirmation, scan failure, write refusal, and Mermaid completion checks.

findings.title: Execution path includes maintenance Sync instructions
findings.evidence: shared/skills/overview/SKILL.md:53 includes Sync maintenance text inside the runtime step contract.
findings.impact: Agents may treat maintainer synchronization work as part of an overview user request.
findings.verification_hint: Move Sync maintenance notes out of runtime steps and keep only Trigger, Read, Expect, Consume, Evidence fields in the execution path.

repair_handoff.action: Remove eval, build find arguments as an array, validate depth, and add shell edge-case tests.
Add executable coverage for overview behavior currently represented only in prompt fixtures.
Move maintenance Sync text out of runtime workflow instructions.
